name: big-bench-hard-continue-finetuning
description: A dataset derived to support continued finetuning on the hardest tasks from the BIG-bench suite. It measures whether finetuning on challenging instances improves model performance on difficult reasoning and knowledge tasks and evaluates generalization to held-out hard tasks. Intended for research on methods to boost large-model capabilities on tasks where zero/few-shot performance is poor.
reputation: Derived from the well-known BIG-bench collection, used by researchers studying finetuning and robustness on challenging tasks.
